column1: # Apple M5 Ultra (Mac17,15), macOS 27.0 (26A428), captured 2026-09-25 by iterating one sample of an unfiltered subscription to the whole "Energy Model" group (IOReportCopyChannelsInGroup, then IOReportCreateSamples) rather than the filtered all-smi subscription: every channel as name<TAB>unit, in sample order. All 725 channels had an empty subgroup. The 300 DTL names (MCPU0DTL*, MCPU1DTL*, PCPUDTL*) each appear twice, with no DIE_ prefix to tell the two apart, and are kept as sampled.
